issues.title: Overview lacked a direct List an Asset action
issues.reproduction: Open Collector workspace Overview and inspect the primary actions.
issues.expected: A clear action starts a new listing.
issues.actual: Only section navigation and membership actions were visible.
issues.rootCause: Overview did not render a listing CTA.
issues.resolution: Added a labelled link to /list using the existing Collector button treatment.

issues.title: Collectibles nav renders Asset Operations instead of a catalogue
issues.reproduction: Open Admin Console, click Collectibles, then compare the heading and controls with Asset Operations.
issues.expected: A canonical Collectibles catalogue with search, identity, media, custody and public-state views.
issues.actual: The Asset Operations pipeline board renders; Collectibles and Asset Operations are duplicate surfaces.
issues.rootCause: admin.tsx routes both section values to AdminAssetOperations and no authoritative admin catalogue-list endpoint/component is present.
issues.recommendedFix: Add a backend-authoritative admin collectibles list projection and a separate catalogue component; keep operations as the lifecycle pipeline.

issues.title: Overall health remains Unknown despite component statuses
issues.expected: A clear aggregate state with explicit unknown/deferred contributors.
issues.actual: Overall health is Unknown while API, PostgreSQL, Redis-backed readiness, storage, Ximilar and PriceCharting are shown as operational.
issues.rootCause: Webhook/feature-flag telemetry is unavailable to the read model.
issues.recommendedFix: Expose an explicit aggregate such as Operational with an Unknown/Not configured component list, without fabricating provider health.

issues.title: My submissions includes legacy demo/draft noise
issues.reproduction: Sign in as the controlled Collector, open /list, and review My submissions after the fresh identify-card draft check.
issues.expected: A customer-facing list should contain the collector's legitimate records, with any retained QA records clearly labelled as controlled demo data.
issues.actual: The list includes multiple older cancelled/demo rows and the fresh QA draft alongside the controlled lifecycle record.
issues.rootCause: Controlled staging fixtures and QA drafts are projected together without an explicit demo/QA label or cleanup path in the customer list.
issues.recommendedFix: Retire or clearly label non-production fixture rows in the Collector projection; preserve supported draft deletion for disposable QA records.

issues.title: Approved submission still presents a review-pending next action
issues.reproduction: Open the controlled Charizard record from My Collectibles and compare the Details status with the journey/sidebar copy.
issues.expected: The customer-facing journey and next action should consistently reflect the authoritative APPROVED state.
issues.actual: Details shows Submission status Approved, while the journey/sidebar still says Submitted and Awaiting staff review; the actionable next step is Add tracking.
issues.rootCause: The workspace stage label and next-action copy are derived from the pre-approval journey wording rather than the authoritative submission status.
issues.recommendedFix: Map APPROVED to an explicit approved/shipping-required presentation and reserve review-pending copy for SUBMITTED/REVIEW states.

issues.title: Intake destination selection was not audited
issues.reproduction: Select an approved intake destination for an APPROVED submission before shipment.
issues.expected: The selection and previous/next destination are recorded atomically with the intake update.
issues.actual: The prior implementation updated SubmissionIntake without an audit event.
issues.rootCause: selectVault used a direct upsert without an audit write.
issues.resolution: selectVault now performs the upsert and INTAKE_DESTINATION_SELECTED audit event in one transaction. Verified on 2026-08-15 for SLICE-3AA5144D.
